# DiskCache { #pymc_cache.DiskCache }

```python
DiskCache(base_dir=None, model=None, *, max_entries_per_model=20)
```

One-file, full-key-verified atomic NetCDF result cache.

Entries live at ``<root>/<model>/<parameters>-<full-sha256>.nc``. Contents
have an independently checked full key and schema; legacy files are never
reused. The directory is a trusted local cache, not an untrusted file reader.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [clear](#pymc_cache.DiskCache.clear) | Delete only format-owned entries, preserving other files. |
| [delete](#pymc_cache.DiskCache.delete) | Remove matching owned entries, never arbitrary files or symlinks. |
| [entries](#pymc_cache.DiskCache.entries) | List this format's entries without materializing posterior data. |
| [prune](#pymc_cache.DiskCache.prune) | Keep the N newest entries per model; return count removed. |

### clear { #pymc_cache.DiskCache.clear }

```python
DiskCache.clear()
```

Delete only format-owned entries, preserving other files.

### delete { #pymc_cache.DiskCache.delete }

```python
DiskCache.delete(key)
```

Remove matching owned entries, never arbitrary files or symlinks.

### entries { #pymc_cache.DiskCache.entries }

```python
DiskCache.entries()
```

List this format's entries without materializing posterior data.

### prune { #pymc_cache.DiskCache.prune }

```python
DiskCache.prune(keep=None)
```

Keep the N newest entries per model; return count removed.
